name: airp
description: Pre-model, compact multi-language source context for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Inject compact source evidence before model execution.
interface.longDescription: AIRP indexes the active repository locally and injects task-specific source evidence before the first model request. Adaptive budgets preserve exact lookups, cross-file reasoning, and impact analysis without an extra model-tool-model round trip.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this repository using the precomputed AIRP context.
Find this symbol and explain its dependencies.
Assess the impact of this code change.
